name: Google
diffReason: Hard: sensitive and restricted scopes need Google verification before more than 100 users can connect, and restricted scopes also need an annual security assessment

steps.d: Add the app name, support email, home page, privacy policy and authorized domains, and choose External or Internal users.
Google Auth Platform → Clients → Create client. Add your HTTPS redirect URIs, then save the client secret: it's shown only once.
Needed for sensitive or restricted scopes, after you publish to production. Restricted scopes such as full Gmail also need a security assessment.

blockers.s: In Testing, only up to 100 listed test users can sign in, and their authorizations expire after seven days.
Restricted scopes need an annual third-party security assessment. Google estimates restricted scope verification at 6 weeks.
Authorized domains must be verified in Search Console.

agent: Write consent-screen text and privacy copy
Map your features to the least sensitive scopes
you: Submit verification and answer Google's questions
